idea: EXTREME regime confidence boost — lower CONF_FILTER_MIN to 60 for EXTREME, keep 70 for NORMAL
rationale: EXTREME: 139T/59%WR/+$2.96. NORMAL: 81T/53.1%WR/-$2.43. Let more signals fire in EXTREME, fewer in NORMAL.

idea: cut-loser-CL-T1 activation delay — 5min grace period for ATR_SL to manage
rationale: cut-loser 0%WR/-$1.06/24h fires before ATR_SL can act. ATR_SL actually profitable at 52.6% WR.

idea: mover- SHORT expansion — add to STANDALONE_BYPASS or lower confidence threshold
rationale: Best R:R in system (2.38), 85.7% WR, but only 7T/7d. Signal starved.

idea: pullback-entry- RR engine resistance +0.1% wider band
rationale: 12 SHORT trades hit resistance and reversed (-$0.60/7d). Wider band lets some reach TP.

idea: NORMAL regime hard blocks for pump_chain and coiled_spring in VOL_PHASE_MULTS
rationale: Current NORMAL penalties (0.6-0.8 mult) let signals fire at low confidence. Data: pump_chain NORMAL -0.031 avg_pnl (60% WR but losers > winners), coiled_spring NORMAL -0.016 avg_pnl. These should be 0.0 BLOCKED like Pullback_Entry_Long already is in NORMAL.

idea: EXTREME-only gate for open_skies — verify family name mapping
rationale: open_skies is EXTREME-dependent: EXTREME +$1.49/8T, NORMAL -$0.35/5T, HIGH -$0.13/3T. Non-EXTREME net -$0.48. Gate has ('NORMAL','*'): 'Open_Skies': 0.0 but trades still exist — possible signal family name mismatch between gate and actual signal.
24h data: 09:00 UTC 4T/25% WR -$0.52 (worst hour). 08:00-10:00 combined is worst 3h window. Legacy sma20_dip dominates but even active signals struggle. Not previously identified.
expected_impact: Block ~5 trades/7d losing ~$0.15 if pattern holds after legacy exits.

idea: Widen PM_TRAIL_ACTIVATE to 0.50% for EXTREME regime only
rationale: EXTREME is best regime (59.3% WR, +$3.20) but R:R dragged by PM_TRAIL capping winners at 0.40%. EXTREME trades have higher MFE — letting them run 0.10% further captures more. Regime-conditional override avoids touching protected global PM_TRAIL.
risk: medium — needs T approval, touches PM_TRAIL logic

idea: REGIME-GATED POSITION SIZE: Scale position size by regime win rate — 2x in EXTREME (58.9% WR), 1x in HIGH (56.9%), 0.5x in NORMAL (50.6%)
rationale: EXTREME is the money printer (+$3.09/7d) but trades get same size as NORMAL (-$2.75/7d). Capital efficiency says: more where it works, less where it doesn't.
expected_impact: +$1.50-2.00/7d by concentrating capital in EXTREME, reducing bleed in NORMAL

idea: CUT-LOSER ADAPTIVE DELAY: MIN_HOLDMinutes scales with regime — 7min EXTREME (fast moves), 15min NORMAL (chop needs recovery time)
rationale: In EXTREME, 7-9min cut-loser exits may be too fast — price whipsaws before recovering. In NORMAL, chop needs even more time. Current flat MIN_HOLD hurts both.
expected_impact: +$0.50-1.00/7d by reducing premature cut-loser exits in choppy regimes
risk: low — delay is small, extends hold time not SL distance

idea: SIGNAL ROTATION: When pump-chain- fires in EXTREME and there's already an open pump-chain- SHORT, skip the new entry — prevents coin clustering (ATOM 4x, APT 3x, ENA 3x in 7d)
rationale: Same-coin clustering (3+ trades on same token from same signal) increases correlation risk. BLUR -$0.42, ICP -$0.13, ARB -$0.13 all from repeated entries.
expected_impact: +$0.30-0.50/7d by avoiding correlated losses on same coin

idea: Add MIN_HOLD_MINUTES=10 to cut-loser-CL-T1 to prevent premature exits
rationale: Data shows cut-loser-CL-T1 exits at 6-9 minutes result in -5.73% to -6.34% loss. Trades need more time to recover from volatile moves.

idea: Reduce position size in NORMAL regime by 50%
rationale: NORMAL regime has 50.6% WR and is losing $2.75/7d. Reducing exposure limits losses while keeping signal generation active.
